activation_baseline.basis: Sylven v676-v7-r2 repository seal plus corrected-composite, delivery, post-delivery, and route-method external overlays, kept separate from Caelen startup failures.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The complete authorization state exceeded one visible display envelope.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Bounded numbered windows completed the same exact file through EOF without changing it.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A combined activation-packet window truncated one middle range.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The missing nonoverlapping range was read directly and packet integrity was preserved.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A PowerShell parent projection used an invalid inline conditional expression.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only the missing parent scalars were rerun with valid materialized expressions.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A worktree inspection repeated the same invalid inline conditional form.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Separate scalar variables recovered branch and path truth without mutation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The worktree-add presentation window elapsed while the original sparse checkout continued.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Process and Git-state inspection waited for the original operation and avoided duplicate creation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A broad recursive lock inspection exceeded its bounded presentation window.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Exact known lock paths and process state replaced the broad inspection.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A premature status read during active sparse checkout emitted a truncated apparent-deletion list.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: After checkout exit, scalar diff, index, status, and untracked counts proved a clean exact-source lane.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A custom manifest probe incorrectly compared checkout byte counts with raw Git-blob byte counts.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Declared normalized-LF hashes replayed exactly and the manifest scripts confirmed checkout-byte semantics.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: Several PowerShell foreach projections were piped without materialization and hit empty-pipe parser faults.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Rows were materialized before conversion and only the missing projections were rerun.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A broad keyword Git-grep produced no attributable bounded output.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The source-bounded semantic audit in the x1 builder became the attributable novelty check.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first source-script inventory projection hit the same empty-pipe parser fault.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The file rows were materialized and the exact source inventory was recovered once.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The sparse checkout was initially observed with zero materialized owner files while its checkout process remained active.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: No operation was repeated; after normal exit the intended empty additive owner scope and clean source head were verified.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: Two exact PowerShell Remove-Item cleanup attempts were rejected by the host command policy before deletion.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only generated owner-worktree bytecode caches were deleted with an exact path-bounded Python fallback after parent-scope assertions.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A nested PowerShell range projection flattened unexpectedly and produced no requested source window.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The one missing bounded source window was emitted with direct scalar bounds and no file mutation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first source-bounded semantic audit failed closed with four exact title collisions and ten rows at or above the 0.75 quarantine threshold.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only the ten named proposal titles were rewritten for semantic distinction; the threshold, source corpus, counts, outcome plan, and protected gates remained unchanged before the isolated audit rerun.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first exact x1 privacy review treated the owner core scanner definitions as two confirmed payload hits.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only the exact owner core scanner-definition path was added to the adjudication allowlist; all five patterns, all payload paths, and fail-closed behavior remained unchanged.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first staged diff-hygiene check found one extra terminal blank line in the owner core and x1 test.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only the two terminal blank lines and one stale runner-description owner label were corrected before regenerating exact manifests.
